result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior finding S0-001 and the directly touched lifecycle seam/export/smoke-test surface. The quick-fix adds a callable fail-closed `disposeInstance` seam, exports it through the package entry, covers it in smoke tests, and both configured gates pass fresh.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `packages/pi-lhc/src/lifecycle/instance.ts:30-32` now exports `disposeInstance(instance: LhcInstance | null): Promise<OpResult<void>>` returning `not_implemented`. `packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:13` exports it from the package entry. `packages/pi-lhc/test/smoke/extension-load.test.ts:85-104` now invokes both `initInstance` and `disposeInstance(null)` and asserts exact typed fail-closed `not_implemented` results. Fresh `pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify` and `pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify-all` both passed.

verified: S0-SMOKE-INIT-DISPOSE: callable init and dispose lifecycle seams now both return typed fail-closed `not_implemented` results.
S0-DOD-INIT-DISPOSE: stubbed LHC init/dispose seam is callable and fail-closed.
S0-PACKAGE-HOOK-RAIL: unchanged touched-surface evidence still shows package entry exports and hook rail compile under the fresh story gate.
S0-GATES: fresh story gate and epic gate passed.

additionalObservations: No new regression was found on the directly touched surfaces.
The new dispose seam remains fail-closed and does not create a fake usable LHC instance.
